paletteEditPrompt: Edit the target scene only. Preserve exact framing, characters, faces, poses, clothes, belongings and narrative action. Use muted-palette-reference.webp as primary colour authority, hero-reference.webp for identity and illustration-style-reference.webp for rendering. Remove broad golden-orange wash; make hall walls/floor neutral warm gray and off-white, reduce amber saturation in skin, hair, coats, bags, foliage and reflections. Keep soft localized warm lamps, natural skin and cool subdued outdoor tones. Indoors remains slightly warmer. Preserve readable details and tonal depth; no flat gray haze, crushed shadows or uniform dark overlay. Same full-bleed 16:9 scene, no text or interface.
